editorial:
Imagine heading to a quiet country house to heal your heart after a big loss, only to find out that Christmas is the worst time for a vacation. You will follow a mother and daughter trying to get their lives back together at Aunt Betty's old place. Everything feels calm and cozy at first, but the mood shifts fast when a weird package arrives on the porch. Once they open it, something evil gets let loose in the house, and the cozy holiday vibes turn into a total nightmare. It is a wild ride that takes the idea of a family reunion and turns it into a scary game of hide and seek.

The acting is great and makes you really care if these two survive. The pacing is quick, so you will not get bored, though some of the jump scares are a bit predictable. If you love movies that mix holiday cheer with blood and screams, you need to see this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the package was a trap set by a cult to bring back a demon. The mother realizes the only way to stop the monster is to burn the house down with the package inside. She barely gets her daughter out before the whole place explodes. Just as they think they are safe, the daughter looks in the mirror and sees the demon's eyes, meaning it found a new home in her.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves scary movies with a holiday twist.
